title: Webhook without a product id bypasses the product filter
persona: Trial user, day 7 (QA-PAYWALL, signed webhooks + forged sl_session cookie)
steps: membership.activated with user id, status active, no product / product_id / access_pass (uid qa_tri_18)
expected: Event for an unknown product is ignored (or at least not trusted).
actual: Accepted, status active, full access. Only events that name a different product are ignored.
